preprocessing_parameters.imputation: Provider-type median for service/peer-deviation features (with global-median and 0.0 fallbacks); global median for always-present ratio/log/beneficiary features
preprocessing_parameters.missingness_flags_description: one binary _missing indicator per service/peer feature, added before imputation

risk_score_methodology: This IsolationForest is the PRIMARY component (weight 0.35) of the platform's unified 0-100 Provider Risk Score. anomaly_score = -pipeline.decision_function(X) (higher = more anomalous). The full risk score additionally combines: Local Outlier Factor percentile (0.15, computed separately, not part of this artifact), geographic/peer benchmark log-deviation percentile (0.20), specialty-peer z-score percentile (0.15), and 3 transparent rule-based flags (0.15). Component scores are percentile-ranked (0-100) within the scored population before weighting. Buckets: Low 0-29, Moderate 30-59, High 60-79, Critical 80-100 (configurable, not clinically/legally validated cutoffs).

output_filenames.required_module: provider_preprocessing.py (must be importable before joblib.load on any artifact containing ProviderFeaturePreprocessor / ClipTransformer)

important_notes: No fraud ground-truth label exists or was used anywhere in this pipeline; the model flags statistical anomalies, not confirmed fraud.
IsolationForest was trained on a 36,108-provider SAMPLE of the full CMS By-Provider file, not the complete national file.
contamination=0.05 sets the internal decision threshold (~5% flagged); this is a configurable assumption, not a validated fraud prevalence rate.
